contract: ../DESIGN-CONTRACT.md — local photo editor; import, preview and export as primary workflow; dark neutral workspace; responsive desktop 1440x900 and mobile390x844.

accessibility.evidence: Browser checks exercised keyboard range adjustment, Cmd-Z, dialog Escape, visible focus outline, associated slider labels and named buttons. Screenshots reviewed for legible controls. This is a bounded interaction review, not a full WCAG or screen-reader audit.

responsive.evidence: 1440x900 editor document fits900px height and1440px width;390x844 viewport has no horizontal overflow and export dialog fits. Screenshots visually reviewed. Mobile adjustments stack vertically; sidebar presets/library/recipes are documented desktop-only controls.

loading.evidence: Delayed browser decode exercised actual importing state; aria-busy true and Import disabled; loading.png retained. Operation then completed normally.

empty.evidence: Fresh profile displays import/sample actions and disables export; desktop-empty.png and first browser-results.json check.

error.evidence: Corrupt PNG and malformed recipe rejected without changing library; storage-denied simulation preserved editing/export. Three regression checks verify persistent unsaved-photo warning, cancellation after selection changes, and thin-image decode/export.

partial.evidence: Mixed valid PNG and unsupported RAW retained valid image, rejected unsupported image with filename; partial-import.png.

success.evidence: Downloaded PNG decoded as320x240 withRGB111 after+1EV; full-resolution sample export1800x1200; JPEG resize1600px; persistence restored settings and source SHA256 after reload.

permission.reason: No account/device authorization or persistent filesystem permission flow is used. Import is an explicit standard file chooser. Unavailable browser storage is exercised as an error state.
